description: ROUTING set (written 2026-10-26, before the router fix). The live demo sent "Which city got the most snow in 2025?" to the ETL agent: the router didn't know weather data is already in the database. Questions about data that's already loaded (daily weather per city in external.weather_daily, from 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-30) must go to the SQL agent; requests to fetch new data from an API, transform files or load a file must go to the ETL agent. The router's answer can vary between runs, so run this set 3 times. Same rule as the other sets: don't change the questions after seeing results.

routing_questions.question: Which city got the most snow in 2025?
What was the coldest day in Winnipeg in 2025?
How much did it rain in Vancouver in March 2026?
Show the daily maximum temperature in Ottawa for January 2025.
Which month was the windiest in Halifax?
Did Calgary riders take more rides on warm days?
What was the average temperature in Toronto in July 2025?
How many days did it snow in Montreal last winter?
Get the hourly weather for Toronto for last week from Open-Meteo and save it as CSV.
Download the daily weather for Paris for 2025 from the Open-Meteo API and save it as Parquet.
Load data/weather/vancouver_hourly.csv into the database as a new table.
Fetch today's weather forecast for Halifax from Open-Meteo.
